items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: The only one I heard that any composing was Clarence Williams, you know, and Pierron.

ctx.x: Did many of the guys do much composing around here?
The only one I heard that any composing was Clarence Williams, you know, and Pierron. Yeah, they know that too. And I heard of them.
Yeah, they were the ones who'd write it down. That's right. That's right. The other guys must have done some composing. Louis, I mean, he didn't. No, he got Sister Kay, he just played it.

items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Buddy Christian, I know him. Clarence Williams. Yeah. I know all them old timers.

ctx.x: Buddy Christian, I know him. Clarence Williams. Yeah. I know all them old timers. Who did they work with, Buddy Christian? Buddy Christian played down at Pete Lowndes, too.
He was at Pete Lowndes at one time, you know.
